edits.new:
Then the document states that no file, no lake path and no data set is part of the contract

  Scenario: AC11 The business rules of section 8 are checked against both documents (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the OpenAPI 3.1 document and the AsyncAPI document of rwb-source-data are published
    When the base path, topic names, Idempotency-Key header, error envelope, versioning, ownership and parameter rules are checked
    Then the base path is /api/recovery/source-data/v1 and no other service path is declared
    Then the topic is rwb.source-data.events.v1 with event names rwb.source-data.<Event>.v1 and .dlt topics
    Then every POST declares the Idempotency-Key header and every error answers one envelope with one message ID
    Then a schema change is additive within a major version and no operation is declared that rwb-source-data does not own
    Then no business value of threshold, tolerance or wait time is fixed in the contract and each is read as a parameter

  Scenario: AC12 A retried or timed-out activity follows its declared retry and timeout (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the activity declarations of the contract jar
    When an activity call fails or exceeds its timeout
    Then the retry policy and the timeout are read as declared parameters, and their values are Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P1-E1002-CON-AC12)
    Then the timed-out call answers the error envelope with a contract code and no case payload

  Scenario: AC13 A status change the model does not allow is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the publish status model of the contract, with the states PENDING and HELD named in AC1
    When a status change is requested that the model does not allow
    Then the service refuses the change with the error envelope and a contract code
    Then the stored publish status is unchanged
